activity_summary: At St Helen's you sat through Candlemas beside Mistress Ansell. Master Thwaite preached on a candle that is spent. He said he would be brief, and he was not. You caught yourself on the owl, and she named it. Sir John Spencer stayed in the Mayor's pew, three rows ahead, and did not speak to you. You went to the table.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat beside her and went up to the table.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Preached on the light and was not brief.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Kept him in the pew and named the owl.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat three rows ahead and did not speak.

entities.name: St Helen's
entities.context: Mentioned in A pew that does not turn

facets.activity: Sat the Candlemas sermon and went to the owl for a minute

quotes.speaker: josias_thwaite
quotes.text: The light is brought into the temple, brethren.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: You are considering the owl. I know the face.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The owl is delivered. I am here.
